text: 创业板指半日跌超2%，医药、消费股逆势走强。 恒指半日涨0.72%，恒生科技指数涨0.37%，恒生生物科技指数涨超2%，芯片股逆市走低。 日本央7月政策会议意见摘要：有委员称日本央行的加息节奏可能比市场预期的更快。 摩根士丹利：上调智谱目标价近72%，算力获取和新融资等支持强劲增长。
text_en: The ChiNext Index fell over 2% in the morning session, while pharmaceutical and consumer stocks gained against the trend. The Hang Seng Index rose 0.72% at midday, the Hang Seng Tech Index gained 0.37%, the Hang Seng Biotech Index rose over 2%, and chip stocks fell against the market. Summary of the Bank of Japan's July policy meeting opinions: Some members noted the pace of BOJ rate hikes could be faster than the market expects. Morgan Stanley raised its target price for Zhipu by nearly 72%, citing strong growth supported by computing power acquisition and new financing.
